read_method: Downloaded 15 PDFs; pdftotext extracted their complete text; inspected actual contextual hits for requested identifiers and expanded policy/incorporation terms. OCRed 129 sparse/image-only pages across the current final plan, CAPER, and 2024 action-plan versions. Source text and OCR outputs are retained. This counterpart search does not assert each paragraph of each carrier received legal interpretation.

reasoned_findings.source_label: 2025–2029 Consolidated Plan, Final Office Copy, 301 PDF pages
reasoned_findings.finding: The monitoring section requires reporting against each subrecipient agreement’s own scope; it does not supply or date that scope. FF/Mercy project records specify allocations, target households and rental assistance service descriptions, not the incorporated operating-guideline edition. The HOME guidelines discussion on p179 concerns resale/recapture/refinancing activities the City is not undertaking, not regular TBRA. Image-only appendix p230 is the public-hearing funding notice, including $200,000 each for FF/Mercy. It is not contract Exhibit A.

Final CAPER and 2024–25 action-plan editions concern program performance, funding, household goals and allocations. The image-only attachments recovered through OCR are federal certifications/application forms and publication/public-participation materials. No actual 2025 HOME exhibit, dated operating-policy appendix or administrative incorporation link was found.

2024/25, 2025/26 and 2026/27 CDBG application handbooks/forms describe applications and public-service funding. Their references to guidelines do not identify the separate HOME contract Operating Guidelines. No requested provider, TBRA or incorporation identifier was found.

ocr_hit_result: Only two requested-term hits across these OCR pages, both provider names in the p230 public funding notice.
visual_review_of_sparse_ocr: 2025 final plan p234: photograph documenting public display of plan binders; no legible incorporated guideline record

unrecovered_candidate.result: Draft 2024–25 CAPER URL returns404; exact archive availability response has no capture. The final 58-page CAPER was retrieved and examined. Unrecovered draft does not establish a new selected instrument or imply the final includes its attachment.
